name: Samophlange (item)
summary: In the Barrens, Samophlange remains hidden in an automated control console. Goblin mechanics cannot explain what the strange component does.

sections.title: A Baffling Contraption
sections.body: Samophlange lies within a Barrens control console, behind a maze of wiring and hollow tubes. Careful searching is needed to free it from its housing. It looks vital to clockwork and steam machinery, yet goblin tinkerers cannot learn its purpose. They plan to send it to the Tinkers' Union in Undermine, though rough handling may break the fragile piece.

sections.title: Curiosity and Catastrophe
sections.body: Sputtervalve, an engineer in Ratchet, plans to send Samophlange to the senior minds of the Tinkers' Union for study. Yet goblin curiosity often upends that plan. When Sputtervalve sets the delicate device down to examine its inner workings, it shatters into scrap.

faq.answer: Samophlange is a strange mechanical component taken from a control console in the Barrens. Its purpose is unknown, and the console around it is crowded with tubes and wires that seem to do nothing useful.

aliases: who do i give the samophlange to
faq.answer: Sputtervalve, an engineer in Ratchet, wants Samophlange brought to him for study. He plans to send it to the Tinkers' Union.

faq.q: What does Sputtervalve do with it?
faq.answer: Sputtervalve plans to send Samophlange to Undermine for study by the Tinkers' Union. First, he sets it down to inspect it, and the fragile mechanism breaks.

faq.q: Where did the samophlange come from?
faq.answer: Samophlange is housed inside an operating console in the northern Barrens, behind layers of confusing machinery that seem to serve no purpose.

angles.text: As an engineer, you may recognize Samophlange as an overcomplicated design. Its intricate exterior hides a mechanism so fragile that it breaks when set on the floor.
